RATIONALE:
Q1: Both release jobs deliberately default to publishing. `.github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:726,771` and `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:6414,6460` resolve `vars.STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED || 'true'` and `${STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED:-true}`. `tests/test_mark_stable_release_tag_refspec_contract.py:1188` pins that literal. #7029 and #7272 made this choice on purpose. `agents.d/7272-release-tagging-default-on.md` already gives the reason for the sibling `RELEASE_TAGGING_ENABLED` switch: the safety control is the fail-closed `CI / lint` gate (`scripts/release_ci_gate.sh`), and defaulting the switch off would only stop releases. That fragment says nothing about `STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED`. That missing note is why activation verification of PR #7207 filed this gap. Option C would bring back the release stall #7029 fixed. Option B leaves the cause in place, so this issue would keep being filed. Option A adds only documentation, keeps all release behaviour, and stops the false gap report.

EXECUTION PLAN (required for any non-letter decision):
Q1:
  strategy: derive_from_repo
  inputs:
    - agents.d/7272-release-tagging-default-on.md (the wording and target section to copy: `<!-- agents: section="Immutable consumer wrapper pins" -->`)
    - .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:721-778 (env default and script fallback for `STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED`)
    - .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:6409-6467 (the same pair)
    - README.md:242-243 (current user-facing description of the switch; leave it unchanged)
    - changelog.d/ (fragment directory; CLAUDE.md §20 format)
  steps:
    - Create `agents.d/7298-stable-release-default-on.md` with one block under `<!-- agents: section="Immutable consumer wrapper pins" -->`. It should say:
      - In the `release` jobs of `mark-stable.yml` and `test-and-mark-stable.yml`, `STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED` resolves as `vars.STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED || 'true'` and `${STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED:-true}`. Unset, empty or `true` (any letter case) publishes. Any other value skips publishing with a `::warning::` and the `STABLE_RELEASE_DISABLED` summary.
      - This is intentional (#7029, #7272). The safety control is the fail-closed `CI / lint` check-run gate, and the switch is an operator's emergency off switch.
      - Activation verification should not report the default-on fallback of `STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED` or `RELEASE_TAGGING_ENABLED` as a gap.
      - To pause releases, set `STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED=false` (or `RELEASE_TAGGING_ENABLED=false`) and `AUTO_RELEASE_STABLE_ENABLED=false`.
    - Add `changelog.d/7298-stable-release-default-on.md`, following the CLAUDE.md §20 fragment format. It records that the default-on stable-release switch is now documented as intentional, so activation verification no longer reports it, and that release behaviour is unchanged.
    - Do not edit workflow YAML, scripts, tests or README.md. Do not edit agents.md directly (§25).
  replaces_acceptance_criterion: "Default STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED to false in both release-job environments and switch scripts; update the switch contract tests and documentation."
  equivalence_argument: The gap was filed because the intended default had no stated reason that activation verification could see. Documenting the reason, in the same place #7272 used for the sibling switch, closes that gap. Release safety stays with the fail-closed CI gate, which keeps running either way.
  reversibility: If a person later wants publishing to default off, a follow-up issue can flip both defaults and the contract-test literal, and remove this fragment. Nothing here blocks that.
